title: vaccaria hispanica subsp. pyramidata
intro: Vaccaria hispanica subsp. pyramidata, commonly known as Vaccaria pyramidata or Pyramid Vaccaria, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is native to the Iberian Peninsula and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins have been identified in Vaccaria pyramidata, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
